description: This file defines the ColumnDimension class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, managing attributes such as column index, width, auto-sizing, and related methods for a worksheet column.

classes.name: ColumnDimension
classes.description: Represents and manages the properties of a worksheet column such as index, width, and auto-sizing within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new ColumnDimension object with an optional column index, defaulting to 'A'.

methods.name: getColumnIndex
methods.description: Returns the column index as a string, e.g., 'A'.

methods.name: setColumnIndex
methods.description: Sets the column index as a string, e.g., 'A', and returns the object for chaining.

methods.name: getColumnNumeric
methods.description: Returns the column index as a numeric value using the Coordinate utility class.

methods.name: setColumnNumeric
methods.description: Sets the column index using a numeric value, converting it to a string, and returns the object for chaining.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the column. Supports conversion to different units of measure if specified.

methods.name: setWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of the column, accepting an optional unit of measure for conversion.

methods.name: getAutoSize
methods.description: Returns whether the column is set to auto-size.

methods.name: setAutoSize
methods.description: Enables or disables auto-sizing for the column, returning the object for chaining.
